title: State-dependent effects of rTMS on cognitive function in bipolar II disorder: A randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial
title_zh: 双盲安慰剂对照试验中双相II型情感障碍患者rTMS对认知功能的状态依赖性影响
abstract: Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) is a promising neuromodulatory approach for cognitive improvement in psychiatric disorders. However, whether concurrent cognitive engagement enhances rTMS-related effects remains unclear. In this exploratory, randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled 2 × 2 factorial trial, 96 euthymic patients with bipolar II disorder and subjective cognitive impairment were assigned to active or sham 10-Hz rTMS combined with either a complex or simple cognitive task. Stimulation targeted the left inferior parietal lobule (IPL) using robot-assisted neuronavigation and was delivered in 10 sessions over 5 consecutive days. The main outcomes included changes in working memory capacity and precision, subjective cognitive performance (Perceived Deficits Questionnaire, PDQ), and resting-state fMRI connectivity within hippocampal and IPL networks. Behavioral outcomes were analyzed using likelihood-based intention-to-treat linear mixed-effects models including time, stimulation, task condition, and their interactions. False-discovery-rate correction was applied across behavioral outcomes. Eighty-three participants completed the trial. In the intention-to-treat analysis including all 96 randomized participants, no stimulation-by-task interaction survived correction for multiple comparisons. Nominal interactions were observed for overall angular error and angular error at set size 2, but both fell short of the corrected significance threshold. The active rTMS and simple cognitive task group showed the most consistent model-estimated within-group improvements across several working-memory outcomes; however, these patterns did not establish superiority over the other factorial conditions. PDQ scores decreased across all four groups, without significant stimulation, task, or interaction effects. Exploratory neuroimaging analyses indicated divergent functional-connectivity changes across intervention conditions. This exploratory trial did not provide statistically robust evidence that concurrent complex cognitive engagement enhanced the acute working-memory effects of IPL-targeted 10-Hz rTMS in euthymic bipolar II disorder, suggesting that task type, cognitive load, and stimulation–task coupling warrant further systematic optimization in future neuromodulation studies. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT06782763
abstract_zh: 重复经颅磁刺激(rTMS)是精神疾病认知改善的有前景的神经调控方法。然而，认知活动是否能增强rTMS的相关效果仍不清楚。在本探索性的随机、双盲、安慰剂对照2×2因子设计试验中，96名主观认知障碍的双相II型情感障碍安慰期患者被分配至活性或安慰剂10 Hz rTMS，并结合复杂或简单的认知任务。刺激靶向左下颞叶(IpL)，采用机器人辅助神经影像导航，并在连续5天内进行10次刺激。主要结局包括工作记忆容量和精度的变化、主观认知表现(感知缺陷问卷, PDQ)以及海马体和IpL网络的静息状态功能连接性。行为结果使用基于 likelihood 的意向性治疗线性混合效应模型进行分析，包括时间、刺激、任务条件及其交互项。行为结果 across 多个结局应用了错误发现率(FDR)校正。83名参与者完成了该试验。在纳入所有96名随机分配参与者的意向性治疗分析中，未发现存活于多重比较校正的刺激×任务交互作用。在未校正显著性阈值下，观察到整体角度误差和2个集大小的角度误差的名义交互作用，但两者均未达到校正后的显著性阈值。活性rTMS和简单认知任务组在多个工作记忆结局中表现出最一致的组内模型估计改善；然而，这些模式未能在其他因子条件中确立优越性。PDQ评分在四个组中均有下降，但未发现显著的刺激、任务或交互作用效应。探索性神经影像分析表明，在干预条件间存在不同的功能连接变化。本探索性试验未提供统计学上健壮的证据，证明在双相II型情感障碍安慰期患者中，左下颞叶靶向10 Hz rTMS的 acute 工作记忆效果被复杂认知活动增强，这表明任务类型、认知负荷以及刺激-任务耦合在未来神经调控研究中值得进一步系统优化。ClinicalTrials.gov 标识符:NCT06782763
